title: Billing and Coding: Superficial Radiation Therapy (SRT) for the Treatment of Nonmelanoma Skin Cancers (NMSC)

codes.1: Below are CPT ® /HCPCS codes related to SRT. Providers are reminded to refer to the long descriptors of the CPT ® codes in their CPT ® books. Per CPT 2026 guidance SRT should not be reported in conjunction with megavoltage (MeV) (77402, 77407, 77412). To bill electronic brachytherapy treatment delivery use CPT code 77437 (e.g., electronic brachytherapy). When billing 77437 for SRT treatment delivery services covered by the LCD providers must append the KX modifier. For SRT treatment planning and simulation aided field setting use CPT code 77436. CPT 77436 is not typically repeated with each treatment except when clinically indicated and documentation supports additional simulation requirements. Do not report clinical treatment planning (77261, 77262, 77263), simulation (77280, 77285, 7729…
codes.2: The following CPT codes are considered not medically reasonable and necessary (non-covered). Electronic brachytherapy is non-covered and must be billed without a KX modifier.

covered.1: CPT codes 77336, 77370 and 77436, when billed with SRT services are not subject to ICD-10-CM limitations, but must relate to reasonable and necessary services per the criteria specified in the local coverage determination for Superficial Radiation Therapy (SRT) for the Treatment of Nonmelanoma Skin Cancers (NMSC). When billing 77437 for services covered by the LCD, providers must append the KX modifier. Medicare is establishing the following limited coverage for CPT code 77437 KX.
